mood_contract: Joyful creation: the student leaves with something recognizably theirs, not a technical warm-up.

intended_learnings.text: Context is whatever the agent reads; it reads the whole conversation every time, so what you add changes what comes out.
Structured guardrails (a framework, your own facts) turn generic output into output that is recognizably yours.
Your own domain knowledge is the check: the agent's self-report is a claim about the work, not a verdict.
What you learned gets packaged as a reusable rules file the agent reads next time.
Mental models come from doing: running the experiment beats reading about agents.
